message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts and determine which crimes are directly supported.

Facts: Yang, a police officer, in handling a drug case, seized 9801g of suspected drug (methamphetamine). He knowingly kept 1896g for himself: 1135g placed at his home, 761g placed in a car, and contacted relatives to find opportunity to sell for profit. Also, he concealed the fact of the seized drugs in his report, and signed release paperwork for a suspect, claiming the suspect was a minor drug user, to get him released.

Thus crimes: (1)贩卖毒品罪 (trafficking/drug trafficking) because he intended to sell. The amount is large, "数量特别巨大". So "贩卖毒品罪" (trafficking of a controlled substance). Possibly "走私、贩卖、运输、制造毒品罪" but the specific is "贩卖毒品罪". (2)徇私枉法, i.e., "徇私枉法罪" (perverting the course of justice) or "滥用职权罪"? He concealed evidence and released suspect. The crime is "徇私枉法罪" (perverting the administration of justice) or "包庇罪". The text says: "被告人杨某徇私枉法，对明知是有罪的人而故意包庇不使他受追诉，其行为应当以××追究其刑事责任。" So they intend to charge him with "徇私枉法罪". In Chinese criminal law, the offense is "徇私枉法罪" (perverting the administration of justice). Also could be "滥用职权罪" (abuse of power) but the description matches "徇私枉法罪". So we list two crimes: 贩卖毒品罪;徇私枉法罪.

Check if any other crimes: "非法持有毒品" maybe, but he is a police officer, he didn't just possess; he had the seized items. The act of "非法占有" is part of trafficking. Also "玩忽职守罪"? He failed to report. But the main is perverting justice.

Thus answer: [罪名]贩卖毒品罪;徇私枉法罪<eoa>
